name: Liquid Metaball
summary: Metrics flow as glossy teal droplets into one calm pool; the anomaly is a coral bead that refuses to merge.
look: Deep-ink ground with glossy teal metaballs that stretch, neck and fuse. One coral bead with ripple rings; crisp mono labels sit outside the liquid.

components.name: Goo filter
components.role: feGaussianBlur + feColorMatrix alpha threshold that makes neighbouring circles fuse

components.name: Droplet
components.role: circle with an off-centre radial gradient and a separate specular highlight

components.name: Channel
components.role: a rounded track each metric's drops flow down

components.name: Merge pool
components.role: the calm body of all healthy metrics

components.name: Rogue bead
components.role: the coral drop that will not merge, with ripple rings — the anomaly

components.name: Label chip
components.role: mono text and the anomaly card kept outside the filter so they stay crisp

motion.name: Path flow
motion.how: drops follow the channel path, power1.in, 0.06 s stagger; one release per beat at 120 BPM

motion.name: Merge snap
motion.how: the neck stretches for 2 frames, then fuses with elastic.out(1, .4) 0.6 s, landing on a downbeat

motion.name: Repel wobble
motion.how: the coral bead squashes ±8 % in a 3-cycle damped sine (0.5 s) on the snare when it refuses to merge

story: Hook: scattered droplets wobble while a coral drop slides off the edge — the drop still shipped Friday. Reveal: every droplet snaps into one pool and the Acme mark surfaces with “Acme Pulse”. Proof: metric channels pour into the pool; the checkout bead refuses to merge and a card reads “Checkout conversion −18% · since 09:42 · after deploy #2231” with “Roll back”. CTA: the pool rises, “You ship. Pulse watches.” and a coral “Start free” drop.
adapt: Make each drop one unit of your product's flow (orders, events, jobs) and the pool the healthy total; the thing your product catches is the drop that won't merge. Keep all labels as crisp overlays.

references.note: droplet metaballs with Three.js and GLSL

fit.risk: The goo filter blurs text inside it; keep every label and number outside the filtered group.
